title: CS prospect cluster -> scoped proposal surge: rapid aggregation & demoable scoping
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Sales/CS are collecting the same class of enterprise feature asks (billing analytics, tenant isolation, and VPC routing adjustments) across multiple accounts. Current intake is ad-hoc: duplicates slip through, priority is account-driven rather than impact-driven, and engineering spends cycles re-scoping similar asks. Goal: ship a lightweight surge process that clusters incoming CS prospects into solution families, produces a demoable scoped proposal for the top clusters within two weeks, and outputs a clear next-step recommendation (PoC / Pilot / Build).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible clustering heuristic that groups >= 70% of incoming enterprise asks into <= 6 solution families
For top 3 clusters, produce a one-page scoped proposal per cluster (problem, proposed approach, minimal success criteria, rough engineering estimate, pilot plan)
Run an internal demo for each scoped proposal with Sales/CS and two engineering leads and collect signoff or clarified next-steps
Artifacts (scoped proposals + short video walkthrough) uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket
A recommended triage rubric that converts cluster signals into priority (impact x feasibility x revenue proxy) is documented and agreed by PM, Sales lead, and Eng lead
tasks: Draft clustering rules and labels (PM) — include keyword mappings, account metadata signals, and urgency tags
Run an initial pass on last 90 days of CS asks to validate cluster coverage (Data/PM)
Create scoped-proposal template (1 page) and example filled from an anonymized real ask (PM/Design)
Estimate engineering effort range for each cluster (Eng) — provide 3 point estimate (S/M/L)
Prepare demo environment or slide deck with two short flows showing expected user impact (Solutions Eng)
Hold internal review & signoff session with Sales/CS, PM, Eng; capture decisions and next actions
